title: Lab transformer C5: Editor approval record for lab criteria
description:
Record, per classifier question, its source (doctrine file/commit) and editor-approval status; criteria text kept in version control.
Acceptance: source and approval status persisted and auditable per question; criteria text in version control.

Size: S
Dependencies: none (precedes lab criteria sign-off)
Epic: Lab is the single classifier per publication (decision-flywheel-1b8b860d). Related: hosted curation epic decision-flywheel-1da33407.

Approved by Ryan 2026-10-22; AWS changes need his explicit approval.

comments.author: home
comments.text: C5 progress: criteria source files (3 classifiers + successor definition), classifier_criteria module with provenance block saved in the classifier config, plan/apply script and offline deploy-equivalence tests are written. Findings from read-only AWS: a new classifier revision cannot move the standing run (run config and engine store freeze the question; ticket ade3088c), so the change is a successor run with a new cyclotron id, binding revision 2, relabelled priming. Runbook in infra/lab/criteria-runbook.md. All three classifiers recorded approved (Ryan, 2026-10-22). make check running; PR next.
